|game_text='''0 side — Mind What You Have Learned'''

Deploy Beldon's Corridor, Yoda's Hut (with [Dagobah] Yoda there), [Cloud City] No Disintegrations!, and Patience! For remainder of game, Sense may not target characters at non-battlegrounds. You may not Force drain on Dagobah. Your non-[Dagobah] characters of ability &gt; 4 (except Ahsoka) are lost. Once per turn, may deploy Bespin system or a Cloud City site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, may deploy Wise Advice or Yoda's Hope from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, may deploy a Dagobah location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May flip this card if Luke on Dagobah during your turn. Save You It Can: Immediately return Luke and any cards on him to owner's hand. While this side up, may deploy Luke (deploy -3) and/or a weapon on him as a 'react.' May place a completed Jedi Test (even if suspended) out of play to take a [Cloud City] Rebel into hand from Lost Pile. When your [Cloud City] Rebel Force drains at a battleground site, unless a captive on table, lost Force must come from top of Reserve Deck if possible.

|rulings=* (7-side) The phrase 'return [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] and any cards on him' refers to cards attached to [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] (e.g. weapons, devices, and Effects), not cards that are 'aboard' him via [[Luke's Backpack]]. If a character is aboard [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]], they are not returned to hand but may 'jump off'.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Mind%20What%20You%20Have%20Learned%20/%20Save%20You%20It%20Can%20%28V%29 Scomp: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* (7-side) Light may react to a single battle with both [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] and a weapon, but if doing so, they are two separate react actions performed one at a time. It Light reacts to a Force drain with [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]], this will typically cancel the Force drain, preventing further reacts.
* (7-side) Placing a completed Jedi Test out of play may be performed multiple times per turn.
|also_known_as=* MWYHL/SYICv
